title: My typing game is live! WIP, any feedback much appreciated
author: wait_whatwait
selftext:
Obstacles come at the hero and you type their names to get past: DOG, LAZY MONKEY, ANNOYING CYCLIST, whole sentences… Type JUMP or SLIDE at the right moment, PARACHUTE when you fall off a cliff, and SHOOT when a target is in range.

* 4 stages (countryside, mountains, town, city) with a day/night cycle and weather
* Chases at the end of each stage, a boss robot, and shooting stars you can make a WISH on
* Laps get faster the longer you survive
* Coins and a small shop (hats, outfits, extra heart)
* Online leaderboard showing score, WPM and difficulty

🎮 Play: [https://albertsola.itch.io/look-up-a-typing-game](https://albertsola.itch.io/look-up-a-typing-game)

Best on desktop, since it needs a real keyboard. No signup, no ads.

It's my first game and I'm still working on it, so I'd love feedback. What felt too hard, too easy or unclear? And what's your best score?

comments.author: MrDankyStanky
comments.body: It seems to easy just from what I've seen here. Maybe different difficulty levels or something?

replies.author: wait_whatwait
replies.body: i have three levels, give it a try! Cheers!

comments.author: king-krool
comments.body: Do you learn the word after you get it right? Also do you ever intend to have two things on screen at once and if so how do you handle starting each word with the same letter

replies.author: wait_whatwait
replies.body: obstacle spawning is random so you get a different run every time you play. For now there is moments you have more than one obstacle  at the same time but you need to handle each in order as they come to you

replies.author: king-krool
replies.body: But sometimes it shows ??? If you guess yeti, the next time you see yeti is it displayed? Or is the obfuscation just randomly applied

replies.author: wait_whatwait
replies.body: it always shows the names for now. The only times there is obfuscation is if there is windy weather that blows away some letters, or snow, that freezes and covers some letters. To add complexity

comments.author: Taniai_
comments.body: I loved it definitely bro , nice idea and good execution of idea

replies.author: wait_whatwait
replies.body: thank you! Will keep improving it!
